title: Manganese-catalyzed dehydroxyamination of catechols for the synthesis of redox-active and heterocyclic scaffolds
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23326-23334
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09855F, Paper
Open Access

Zahra Naseri Motlagh, Jasem Aboonajmi, Farhad Panahi, Laleh Khalvati, Hashem Sharghi
A catalytic protocol employing manganese(II) nitrate [Mn(NO3)2] has been developed for the selective C–O bond cleavage of catechols, enabling subsequent C–N bond formation.
